rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING THE RIGHTS OF PATIENTS AND PRESCRIBING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF
rows.abstract: Rationale: A contractual relationship between a physician and his patients exists and is recognized. It is characterized by a mutual agreement by both the physician and the patient - the physicial consents to render medical service.  The relationship is also fiduciary which means that it is based on mutual trust and confidence in one another.  By virtue  of the physician's education, training, expertise and skill, the former acquires intimate knowledge of an exercises considerable power over their patient's health. "Patients Rights Act of 1996" Aims to equalize the contractual relationship between a patient and his physician by stating the RIGHTS OF PATIENTS, such as the right to --- (1) medical care and treatment; (2) informed consent; (33) privacy; (4) choose his physician; (5) religious belief; and (6) privileged communication.

rows.abstract: "Mental Health Act of the Philippines" Mandates the adoption of a COMPREHENSIVE AND INTEGATED MENTAL HEALTH PROGRAM that shall --- (1) protect and promote the mental health of the nation through a multi-disciplin ary approach that encompasses health, education, labor and employment, justice, and social welfare; (2) prevent, treat, and control mental illness and rehabilitate the mentally disabled; (3) establish a nationwide multi-sectoral campaign for the identification and prevention of mentalill-health, particularly among the children and youth; and (4) provide primary, secondary, and tertiary levels of health care which ensure a well-balanced program of community-based and hosital or institutional care and treatment, with voluntary andinvoluntary access to such care and treatment.

rows.title_full: AN ACT FIXING THE MINIMUM SALARY GRADES OF GUIDANCE COUNSELOR III AND GUIDANCE COORDINATOR IN PUBLIC ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY SCHOOLS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE COMPENSATION AND POSITION CLASSIFICATION ACT OF 1989
rows.abstract: Rationale: The position of Guidance Counselor is a unique and distinct item. Accodingly, those appointed to it go through entry and hiring procedures that are more rigid than those undergone by ordinary classroom teachers. entry to such a position requires: (a) recommendationb y the school principal; (b) technical and oral sccreening by the DECS' Promotion Board; (c) minimum of three years experience as a classroom teacher; and (d) minimum of eighteen units in guidance and counselling and/or other related fields on the masteral level. Considering these qualifications and the gret responsibility assigned to a Guidance Counselor, it is but fair and appropriate that the position be assigned a minimum salary grade 16.> Proposes these salary grrade assignments for two (2) positions: Guidance Counselor III - 16; Guidance Coordinator - 18.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on APPROPRIATIONS since 1996-10-14

rows.title_full: AN ACT REORGANIZING THE PHILIPPINE STATISTICAL SYSTEM
rows.abstract: Rationale: The Philippine Statistical System (PSS), in its present stage, is mandated to provide accurate and precise data for the process of planning, implementation and evaluation of government plans and projects for national development. It mustbe guided by the universal principles of objectivity through the use of sound scientific statistical theories and techniques, run by statistical professionals with known expertise, and its oeprations must be independent of any political or other pressure. "Philippine Statistical System Reorganization Act of 1996" Provides for these significiant areas of concern: (1) The structurual and functional reorganization of the PSS: (2) The independence of the PSS from the control of the NEDA; (3) Upgradiing of the Civil Registration and Vital Statistics Division to an OFFICE OF THE CIVIL REGISTRATION GENERAL; and (4) Standardization and rationalization of the position classification and schemes of the personnel government statistical agencies.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A COMPREHENSIVE JUVENILE JUSTICE SYSTEM, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: "Comprehensive Juvenile Justice System" Applies to all youth offenders who are nine (9) years, but under 18 years of age at the time of the commission of the offense. > A youth offender who is nine years of age or underr at the time of a commissionof an offense shall be exempt from criminal liability and shall be committed to the care of his or her father or mother, or nearest relative or family friend, at the discretion of the juvenile court to be established by this Act, and subject to its supervision. The same action shall apply to a youth offender who is nine years of age but under fifteen years of age at the time of the commission of an offense, unless he acted with discernment, in which case he shall be proceeded against in accordannce with Section 6 of this Act."

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING A MECHANISM BY WHICH THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT CAN GUARANTEE REPAYMENT OF LOANS SECURED FROM THE COMMERCIAL CREDIT MARKET BY LOCAL GOVERNMENTS
rows.abstract: Declares that the national government may GUARANTEE loans secured from the commercial credit market by local governments and, on the event of DEFAULT, may WITHHOLD their internal revenue allotments for DIRECT PAYMENT to financial institutions granting the loan. > Identifies the types of services covered by such loans, such as (1) primary health care; (2) potable water; (3) solid waste disposal ; (4) roads; (5) power; and (6) nutrition.
